title: Glucose Report Phone on Black Rock
whatItIs: A light grey board with a card showing a dot-patterned bar chart with one solid black bar tagged Normal, and below it a tilted phone balanced on black rock showing a multi-colour gauge and the same chart.
whatItMeans: Polka-dot bars and a single black bar turn data into a friendly graphic, and the rock adds a grounded contrast to the airy blue.
techniques: Dot texture fills on bars with one solid highlight
